attributes.action: Require public parks to have secure perimeter fencing and child-safe gates
attributes.additional_details:
Children should be able to play in public parks in a safe environment.

We want the Government to introduce national requirements for public parks to have appropriate perimeter fencing and secure, child-safe gates. Parks should have appropriate safety measures based on their location, layout and the risks present. We believe that secure boundaries and child-safe gates can help prevent young children from accidentally leaving a play area and entering nearby hazards.
attributes.background: We call the Government to introduce national requirements for public parks and recreational green spaces to have appropriate perimeter fencing and secure, child-safe gates where this is necessary to protect children, particularly where parks are located next to roads, waterways or other hazards.

rejection.details:
We have a petition open on this subject already, which you may wish to sign:

Require safer, taller fencing and secure child-proof gates at children’s play
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782092
